component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.fwdIn = m.top.findNode("fwdIn") m.fwdOut = m.top.findNode("fwdOut") m.selfAway = m.top.findNode("selfAway") m.fwdIn.observeField("focusedChild", "onFwdIn") m.fwdOut.observeField("focusedChild", "onFwdOut") m.selfAway.observeField("focusedChild", "onSelfAway") m.top.findNode("fwdIn2").observeField("focusedChild", "onFwdIn2") m.top.findNode("fwdOut2").observeField("focusedChild", "onFwdOut2") m.top.findNode("selfAway2").observeField("focusedChild", "onSelfAway2") m.timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.5 m.timer.observeField("fire", "runCases") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub onFwdIn() if m.fwdIn.focusedChild <> invalid and m.fwdIn.focusedChild.isSameNode(m.fwdIn) then m.top.findNode("fwdInChild").setFocus(true) end sub
sub onFwdOut() if m.fwdOut.focusedChild <> invalid and m.fwdOut.focusedChild.isSameNode(m.fwdOut) then m.top.findNode("outside").setFocus(true) end sub
sub onSelfAway() if m.selfAway.focusedChild <> invalid and m.selfAway.focusedChild.isSameNode(m.selfAway) then m.top.findNode("leaf").setFocus(true) end sub
function focusedSelf(id as string) as boolean node = m.top.findNode(id) return node.focusedChild <> invalid and node.focusedChild.isSameNode(node) end function
sub onFwdIn2() if focusedSelf("fwdIn2") then m.top.findNode("fwdInChild2").setFocus(true) end sub
sub onFwdOut2() if focusedSelf("fwdOut2") then m.top.findNode("outside").setFocus(true) end sub
sub onSelfAway2() if focusedSelf("selfAway2") then m.top.findNode("leaf").setFocus(true) end sub
function where() as string f = m.top.focusedChild path = "" while f <> invalid path = path + "/" + f.id if f.focusedChild = invalid or f.focusedChild.isSameNode(f) then exit while f = f.focusedChild end while return path end function
sub probe(label as string, id as string) node = m.top.findNode(id) r = node.setFocus(true) print "PROBE|" + label + "|ret=" + r.toStr() + " hasFocus=" + node.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + node.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " chain=" + where() end sub
sub runCases() probe("A", "leaf") probe("B", "leaf") probe("C", "fwdIn") probe("D", "fwdOut") probe("E", "selfAway") probe("F", "buttons") probe("G", "nope") probe("A2", "leaf2") probe("B2", "leaf2") probe("C2", "fwdIn2") probe("D2", "fwdOut2") probe("E2", "selfAway2") print "PROBE|done" end sub
